🎓 Welcome to Swiftly Convert App

Welcome to my website. I am Vũ Huỳnh Gia Bảo, and I am delighted that you have chosen to use my product.

Swiftly Convert App is a free, browser-based utility that converts images and documents into one another while preserving their original appearance as faithfully as a web browser permits.

Quick guide

  1. Add your files. Drag and drop images or documents (TXT, DOCX, PDF, PPTX, XLSX, CSV) onto the corresponding drop zones, or click a zone to browse your device.
  2. Organise them. Reorder, rotate or remove any item; images are sorted alphabetically by default.
  3. Configure the output. Select the paper size, orientation, margins, image quality and target format. The "Layout mode" option determines whether the original appearance is retained or only the text is extracted for editing.
  4. Convert to images. Choosing JPG or PNG opens an advanced panel in which you may specify the resolution, dimensions and quality before converting.
  5. Convert and download. Press "Convert", then use the download buttons that appear.
  6. Same-format files. If a file already has the chosen format, you will be asked to confirm; confirming copies the original intact, optionally compressed by "Reduce file size".
  7. Personalise. Use "Switch themes" and the language selector in the upper-right corner.

Privacy

All processing takes place locally within your browser; none of your files is ever uploaded to a server.

A closing wish

I sincerely wish you a productive, seamless and rewarding experience. May your work flourish, and thank you for visiting.

⚠️ Cảnh báo

Bạn đang tiến hành chuyển đổi file cùng định dạng với file ban đầu bạn có chắc chắn muốn chuyển đổi chứ?

Tệp bị ảnh hưởng:

    Chọn "Có" để sao chép nguyên bản (và nén nếu bạn đã tick Giảm dung lượng file). Chọn "Không" để xóa các tệp này khỏi danh sách và dừng lại.
